title: Lucky: produto
description: Quantas guildas usam o Lucky, quantas voltam e quais comandos usam. Fonte: Postgres (somente leitura).

list.name: excluidas
list.description: Guildas do operador, de listagem e de teste: nunca contam como uso.

list.name: guilda
list.label: Guilda
list.description: Filtra os painéis de comandos por uma guilda.
list.query: SELECT "discordId" AS __value, coalesce(name, "discordId") AS __text FROM guilds ORDER BY 2
list.definition: SELECT "discordId" AS __value, coalesce(name, "discordId") AS __text FROM guilds ORDER BY 2

list.name: comando
list.label: Comando
list.description: Filtra os painéis de comandos por um comando.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT command FROM command_events WHERE "occurredAt" > now() - interval '90 days' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT command FROM command_events WHERE "occurredAt" > now() - interval '90 days' ORDER BY 1

options.content: **Guilda ativa** = tocou uma faixa ou usou um comando. Guildas do operador, de listagem e de teste não contam. Não há contagem de pessoas: o Grafana não lê ids de usuário (privacidade). `track_history` guarda só 30 dias e `command_events` 180 dias, então janelas antigas contam só comandos. Funil de ativação e metas do music-first: [Lucky: negócio](/d/lucky-negocio). Os filtros **Guilda** e **Comando** no topo valem para a seção Comandos.

panels.title: Ativas nas últimas 24 h
panels.description: Normal: acompanha o WAG. Zero com o bot no ar é preocupante (ninguém conseguiu usar).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT g) AS "Guildas" FROM (SELECT "guildId" AS g, "playedAt" AS t FROM track_history UNION ALL SELECT "guildId", "occurredAt" FROM command_events WHERE "guildId" IS NOT NULL) a WHERE t >= now() - interval '1 days' AND g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')

panels.title: Ativas em 7 dias
panels.description: Mesmo número do WAG (7 dias) do dashboard negócio.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT g) AS "Guildas" FROM (SELECT "guildId" AS g, "playedAt" AS t FROM track_history UNION ALL SELECT "guildId", "occurredAt" FROM command_events WHERE "guildId" IS NOT NULL) a WHERE t >= now() - interval '7 days' AND g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')

panels.title: Ativas em 30 dias
panels.description: Base de guildas que usaram o Lucky no último mês.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT g) AS "Guildas" FROM (SELECT "guildId" AS g, "playedAt" AS t FROM track_history UNION ALL SELECT "guildId", "occurredAt" FROM command_events WHERE "guildId" IS NOT NULL) a WHERE t >= now() - interval '30 days' AND g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')

panels.title: Fidelidade (diárias / mensais)
panels.description: Parte das guildas ativas no mês que usaram o Lucky nas últimas 24 h. Acima de 20% é bom; abaixo de 10% quer dizer que a maioria usa uma vez e some.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT g) FILTER (WHERE t >= now() - interval '1 day') / nullif(count(DISTINCT g), 0), 1) AS "DAU/MAU (%)" FROM (SELECT "guildId" AS g, "playedAt" AS t FROM track_history UNION ALL SELECT "guildId", "occurredAt" FROM command_events WHERE "guildId" IS NOT NULL) a WHERE t >= now() - interval '30 days' AND g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')

panels.title: Guildas ativas por dia, semana e mês
panels.description: Para cada dia: guildas ativas naquele dia, nos 7 e nos 30 dias até ele. Normal: as três linhas sobem juntas. Mensais subindo e diárias paradas = guildas novas que não voltam. Antes de 30 dias atrás só os comandos contam.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT g, t FROM (SELECT "guildId" AS g, "playedAt" AS t FROM track_history UNION ALL SELECT "guildId", "occurredAt" FROM command_events WHERE "guildId" IS NOT NULL) x WHERE t >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '30 days' AND g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')), d AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp), date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp), interval '1 day') AS day) SELECT d.day AS time, (SELECT count(DISTINCT g) FROM a WHERE t >= d.day AND t < d.day + interval '1 day') AS "Diárias", (SELECT count(DISTINCT g) FROM a WHERE t >= d.day - interval '6 days' AND t < d.day + interval '1 day') AS "Semanais (7 dias)", (SELECT count(DISTINCT g) FROM a WHERE t >= d.day - interval '29 days' AND t < d.day + interval '1 day') AS "Mensais (30 dias)" FROM d ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Retenção por semana de entrada (D1, D7, D30)
panels.description: Guildas que entraram em cada semana (entrada contada: reentrada em até 30 dias conta uma vez) e a parte que voltou a tocar ou usar comando a partir do dia 1, 7 e 30 depois da entrada. Vazio = a semana ainda não chegou naquele dia. Normal: D1 > D7 > D30. D7 abaixo de 10% em várias semanas seguidas é preocupante (a meta do music-first é 15% no dia 8).

targets.rawSql: WITH counted_joins AS ( SELECT g, t FROM ( SELECT "guildDiscordId" AS g, "occurredAt" AS t, lag("occurredAt") OVER (PARTITION BY "guildDiscordId" ORDER BY "occurredAt") AS prev FROM guild_membership_events WHERE kind = 'JOIN' ) j WHERE prev IS NULL OR t - prev > interval '30 days' ), j AS (SELECT g, t FROM counted_joins WHERE t > now() - interval '120 days' AND g NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%')), r AS (SELECT j.t, j.t <= now() - interval '1 days' AS e1, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT "guildId" AS g, "playedAt" AS t FROM track_history UNION ALL SELECT "guildId", "occurredAt" FROM command_events WHERE "guildId" IS NOT NULL) a WHERE a.g = j.g AND a.t >= j.t + interval '1 days') AS d1, j.t <= now() - interval '7 days' AS e7, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT "guildId" AS g, "playedAt" AS t FROM track_history UNION ALL SELECT "guildId", "occurredAt" FROM command_events WHERE "guildId" IS NOT NULL) a WHERE a.g = j.g AND a.t >= j.t + interval '7 days') AS d7, j.t <= now() - interval '30 days' AS e30, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT "guildId" AS g, "playedAt" AS t FROM track_history UNION ALL SELECT "guildId", "occurredAt" FROM command_events WHERE "guildId" IS NOT NULL) a WHERE a.g = j.g AND a.t >= j.t + interval '30 days') AS d30 FROM j) SELECT date_trunc('week', t)::date AS "Semana de entrada", count(*) AS "Entraram", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE e1 AND d1) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE e1), 0), 1) AS "D1 (%)", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE e7 AND d7) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE e7), 0), 1) AS "D7 (%)", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE e30 AND d30) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE e30), 0), 1) AS "D30 (%)" FROM r GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

defaults.noValue: sem guildas novas nos últimos 120 dias

panels.title: Comandos por dia
panels.description: Barras laranja = uso errado, sem permissão ou falha (detalhe em Lucky: erros). Normal: laranja pequeno perto do verde.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', ce."occurredAt") AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ce.outcome = 'ok') AS "Deram certo", count(*) FILTER (WHERE ce.outcome <> 'ok') AS "Não deram certo" FROM command_events ce WHERE $__timeFilter(ce."occurredAt") AND coalesce(ce."guildId", '') NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%') AND ('${guilda:raw}' = 'todas' OR ce."guildId" = '${guilda:raw}') AND ('${comando:raw}' = 'todas' OR ce.command = '${comando:raw}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Comandos mais usados
panels.description: Mais de 10% que não deram certo num comando costuma ser texto de ajuda confuso ou um bug.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ce.command AS "Comando", count(*) AS "Usos", count(DISTINCT ce."guildId") AS "Guildas", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE ce.outcome <> 'ok') / count(*), 1) AS "Não deram certo (%)" FROM command_events ce WHERE $__timeFilter(ce."occurredAt") AND coalesce(ce."guildId", '') NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%') AND ('${guilda:raw}' = 'todas' OR ce."guildId" = '${guilda:raw}') AND ('${comando:raw}' = 'todas' OR ce.command = '${comando:raw}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Guildas que mais usam comandos
panels.description: Uma guilda com muito mais comandos que as outras pode ser um teste ou uso automatizado.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(gu.name, ce."guildId") AS "Guilda", count(*) AS "Comandos", count(DISTINCT ce.command) AS "Comandos diferentes", max(ce."occurredAt") AS "Último uso" FROM command_events ce LEFT JOIN guilds gu ON gu."discordId" = ce."guildId" WHERE $__timeFilter(ce."occurredAt") AND ce."guildId" IS NOT NULL AND ce."guildId" NOT IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array('$excluidas', ',')) UNION SELECT "discordId" FROM guilds WHERE name ILIKE '%test%' UNION SELECT "guildDiscordId" FROM guild_membership_events WHERE "guildName" ILIKE '%test%') AND ('${guilda:raw}' = 'todas' OR ce."guildId" = '${guilda:raw}') AND ('${comando:raw}' = 'todas' OR ce.command = '${comando:raw}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20
